subject.title: fix(ui): keep stray file drops from leaving Control UI

question: Should the file-drop protection be a root-app invariant covering boot, login, terminal-only, and standalone approval views, rather than a Control UI shell-only behavior?
rationale: The reported data-loss-style navigation problem is broader than the mounted chat shell, while the protected maintainer label requires explicit review of the intended Control UI boundary.

options.title: Guard every root-app state
options.body: Register the fallback at the always-mounted app or document boundary and test a non-shell view while preserving accepted drop targets and enabled file inputs.

options.title: Limit the scope to the chat shell
options.body: Keep the current placement only if maintainers explicitly accept that other Control UI states may retain browser-default file-drop navigation.

recommendation.title: Guard every root-app state
recommendation.body: Register the fallback at the always-mounted app or document boundary and test a non-shell view while preserving accepted drop targets and enabled file inputs.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current repair and can clarify the intended Control UI scope with reviewers.
